findings: Category field still present in ProductCard — The review instructions state category should be removed, but ProductCard still references product.categoryId in its props type (inherited from the Product type). No visual category display exists in the current implementation, so this is a type-level concern only.

Variants UI is decorative — The add-product form collects variant name and price in local state (variants, variantName, variantPrice), displays added variants with remove functionality, but saveProduct never reads the variants state. No database table, no API parameter, no persistence. Either remove the variants section entirely or implement full variant support (schema, repository method, API, display).
